TnXpEventTypeKillDecoyTrap.Description: You killed an enemy after they were stunned by your trap.

trap_visual.rule: TnDecoyTrap has no mesh: DroppedPickupMesh None, PickupFactoryMesh = MeshComponentA whose StaticMesh is unset through the chain (TnBuffPickup.MeshComponentA sets only render flags). TnAbilityDecoyTrap.OnDropInventory -> SetDecoyWeapon(owner current weapon class): the dropped trap shows THAT WEAPON's pickup mesh (RE §2, CONFIRMED). So the trap mesh, materials and defrag material are the per-weapon ones already exported in VerticalSlice/Weapons/<W>/weapon.{glb,json}.
trap_visual.scale: weapon PickupScale (HIGH: the dropped-weapon path applies it as for a real drop)
trap_visual.defragger: Defragger0: TnDefragger with no authored values through the chain (the fade-in / glitch drives the weapon material's defrag parameter; the WEP materials sample WEP_Shared_p WEP_Defrag_Alphas)

collision.note: Cylinders only; no mesh collision (the weapon mesh is not a collider: TnBuffPickup.MeshComponentA CollideActors false). InstantKillDamageTypes and CanBeDestroyed are in the resolved TnDroppedPickupDecoyTrap values.

roles.HitReactions_React_DecoyTrap: present in the AnimSets; no class references it (UNKNOWN use)

animations.note: No dedicated deploy or hold anim exists: the ability plays Skill_Barrier (the Barrier ability's clip) once at trigger; there is no hold state. The stun clips play in robot form only (RE §4); a vehicle-form victim gets no anim. AnimSet = AnimName lookup on the pawn's own sets (AnimSet None in the CDO).

loop.in_explode_cue: WL_TRANS_POWER.TRANS_POWER_TRAP_ELEC_LP (4.59 s) is a LAYER of DECOY_TRAP_EXPLODE: one wave event with a volume envelope 0 -> 1 by 0.15 s, held to 4.10 s, 0 at 4.57 s, pitch -36 -> 0 over 0.28 s. With the _EXPLO hit, a random KAMIKAZE_EXPL_0x (pitch var 2) and a random DEATH_LIGHT_0x at 3.50 s (-3 dB), the cue is a ~5 s one-shot spanning the stun.
loop.root_LoopStart_LoopEnd: the cue root carries LoopStart 0.320 / LoopEnd 1.052; what the HM root does with them is UNKNOWN (no RE note).

audio.note: BL_TRANS_POWER has only DECOY_TRAP_DEPLOY / DECOY_TRAP_EXPLODE for the decoy, and no decoy class carries an ambient / loop sound property; the trap is silent while it lies on the ground. Each wave has its .wav and .fsb in ExtractedAssets/content.

fx.note: There is no trap-specific idle or explode particle system in the cook: the trap shows the weapon mesh + the inherited dropped-pickup PickupEffect / HighlightFx, and the "explode" is only the pickup sound (RE §4).

not_in_dump: a trap mesh of its own (by design: the thrower's weapon mesh)
a dedicated deploy / hold anim (Skill_Barrier is reused; no hold)
death_Decoy as an animation (it is the kill-feed icon texture)
